name: Bank of Maharashtra
about: Bank of Maharashtra provides various banking products and services in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company accepts savings, current, term, and recurring deposits, as well as provides capital gain account schemes. It also offers housing loans, vehicle and car loans, topup loans, education loans, gold loans, personal loans, salary gain schemes, green financing schemes, rooftop solar panel loans, and adhaar loans, as well as loans against properties and deposits; working capital, term, project, infrastructure, export, and bill financing services; lines of credit; commercial lease rental services; accounts takeover services; non-fund based services; micro, small, and medium enterprise loans; and agriculture loans and other services. reasons: Price implies only ~1% a year growth, below the ~16% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
Trades at PE 10 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 19 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
